notes: True homograph of the existing H6329 (פּוּק, "bring out; obtain") -- same bare consonants פוק, genuinely unrelated meanings -- added as פוק¹ (lower Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H6329 is retroactively renamed פוק² in this same batch. H6329's own notes already anticipated this exact split.

Both requested stems confirmed attested: qal "reel" (Isa.28.7, פָּקוּ, "they stumble in judgment") and hiphil "cause to totter" (Jer.10.4, יָפִיק, said negatively of an idol that "will not totter/move").
